description: Millimeter accurate multi-view stereopsis reconstructions of railway profiles in Southern Africa is a data set deposited in University of Pretoria by its authors André Broekman. This dataset forms part of the thesis titled : Railway conditioning monitoring using a hybrid multi-view stereopsis and real-time kinematic geolocation pipeline for dense reconstruction: The "MVSNet.zip" archive contains the associated Spooroog software (Python) and trained neural networks that were developed to post-process the datasets, as described in Chapter 6 of the thesis. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 49171801994 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
